newsitem.title: RUSSIA: MGTS sees 97 sales 18 pct higher than 96.
newsitem.headline: MGTS sees 97 sales 18 pct higher than 96.

text.p: Sales for Russian regional telecom Moscow City Telephone (MGTS) will rise 17.9 percent this year from 1996, the company's chief executive said on Wednesday.

"It is going to be a slightly more difficult year than in 1996," Vladimir Lagutin told a news conference. "The rate of growth will be significantly lower." Sales in 1996 were 79.6 percent higher than in 1995.

MGTS forecasts distributed at the news conference showed 1997 net profit to Russian accounting standards calculated on an accruals basis would be 401.5 billion roubles and that 1996 net was 345.9 billion roubles.
Russian accounting standards are calculated for tax purposes.
